videos.title: You Actually Can Get Rid of Forever Chemicals
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
If you’ve used non-stick cookware recently or bought water-resistant clothes, you might have heard about PFAS, or “forever chemicals.” And while it is very hard to break down the PFAS polluting our environment, it is not impossible. Here is how we might get rid of forever chemicals.

Hosted by: Sava

videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
